text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Yamanin Zephyr said she 
wanted to walk a bit more, so we came to 
the forest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Sunlight filtering through the swaying 
leaves, sparkling... How elegant.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...! ...It's a dry wind...!

Yamanin Zephyr's voice stiffens. Looking 
ahead, I see plastic bags and empty cans 
strewn about, half-buried under the low 
trees!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't seem like it was carried off 
by the wind... Most likely, someone threw 
it away as trash..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that.

"Having procured trash bags, the forest 
cleanup began. It seems it was all dumped 
in one concentrated spot, so this should 
be done in no time."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
These cans... and containers, too... None 
of them will return to the earth.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, the whirlwind of those who 
dwell in the forest will be thrown into 
disarray...

I can feel the anger coming from Yamanin 
Zephyr. Knowing how deeply she loves 
nature, I understand completely how she 
feels.

At the very least, I'll clean up all the 
trash within arm's reach... Just as I 
thought that—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer? Ah... your hand is bleeding... 
You must have cut it on the can lid...”

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Please stay calm. I will be right back...!

Returning promptly as promised, she held 
several stalks of grass and tree leaves 
clutched in her hand.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's a medicinal herb. When I was young 
and got injured in the forest, I often 
used this plant.

Saying so, Yamanin Zephyr plucked some 
grass and let the dripping moisture fall 
onto my wound. Then, she placed an oval 
leaf over it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...After a while, it should turn into a 
gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I was just wondering why you'd go this 
far for me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The forest brings blessings, but also 
danger. One might end up injured, just as 
you have now...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... you spent time in the forest 
with me, Trainer, and even tried to 
protect me."

Just as I was about to say it was because 
I wanted to know Yamanin Zephyr better, 
and because I wanted to cherish the nature 
she loves—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However... reasons are mere trifles, like 
a gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You love nature as well, Trainer. Just 
that truth alone is comforting...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Auspicious winds and bright breezes blow 
against me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So, please... I hope today won't make you 
hate the forest...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...! Fufufu... It's like a refreshing 
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The breeze that blows from you is always 
so gentle. Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I could simply sway in this pleasant south 
wind forever... but it seems the breeze is 
beginning to take on the hues of sunset.
choice_data_list: ...Shall we get back to picking up trash?
Be careful not to get hurt either, okay!
Be careful not to get hurt yourself, okay!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, only a little remains. Let us finish 
this and summon the auspicious breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Along with a gust of wind, everything 
before my eyes went completely white!? 
This isâ

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufu... Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A plastic bag stuck to your face... Trash 
really is the desiccating winter wind, 
isn't it? Ufufufu.

Yamanin Zephyr and I looked at each other 
and burst into shared laughter!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... Shall we do that, then?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Lal-lala~~âª Lu~rululu~~âª

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Chirping only invites more chirping, 
you know...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Right, Trainer?

Yamanin Zephyr urges me on with a smile. 
And so, humming together, the two of us 
enjoyed a brief moment of rest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I'm used to it. Oh, Trainer, there's a 
slope ahead."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you take smaller steps and keep your 
feet close to the ground, you can descend 
safely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're quite good at this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, this feels like the complete 
opposite of usual. It's as if I've become 
the Trainer today.

Guided by a seemingly delighted Yamanin 
Zephyr, we made our way through the woods 
and returned safely to the Academy.
